title: Ambush at the felled oak
text: Escorting Bram the tinker toward Imre, Sebak spots a felled oak across the road. A crossbowman waits in an ash tree and two brigands crouch in the hawthorn ditch. Sebak acts first in the surprise round.

title: The crow in the wind
text: At the felled oak Sebak dropped the crossbowman from behind, killed one brigand and fell to the other's club. As the final blow came down, something in his blood answered: every scrap of iron and wood nearby rang like a struck bell, the brigand's club burst apart in his hands, and he fled screaming into the hawthorn. Sebak woke at 1 HP, empty of chakra and shaking, with Bram bleeding beside him and the crossbowman still senseless in the ash tree.

title: A roof in Imre
text: Sebak drove Bram through the night to Imre and found an apothecary awake before dawn. He paid a talent for Bram's treatment, got a loft and a stall for the mule, and slept until midday, rested and whole.

title: A report at the south gate
text: On the apothecary's advice, Sebak reported the ambush to Sergeant Haldric Voss at the south gate. He told it plainly: the crossbowman in the ash, the two brigands, one dead, one fled, and Bram wounded. Voss held the looted crossbow for a month on a receipt and is sending men for the bodies. Sebak recalled that the crossbowman waited patiently, aimed at Bram and not at him, and carried a small iron key, which Sebak kept. Voss thinks the man was hired. Sebak will be at the apothecary's or the wharf.

title: A visitor in the loft
text: In the small hours the twine alarm tugged Sebak awake to find a masked intruder at Bram's strongbox. Sebak slammed the hatch, failed to sweep the intruder's legs and took a short blade across the ribs, then flickered behind him and wounded him, burned him through the blood on his own blade with the lantern's flame, and knocked him senseless with the pommel. Marta woke below and called up. The intruder lies unconscious and unmasked-not-yet in the loft.
